title: same-origin iframe running create is removed by its parent mid-request

unsafe.definition: a passkey for rp-a.test in the vault (outside the trash) after the frame that asked was removed

note: HTML: removing the iframe discards its document (no longer fully active); L3 §5.1.3 lifecycle: the operation is aborted, nothing can be delivered, and the provider window must close. UNCERTAIN: the top page has to report. Changed after review U4-13: the one allowed window counts as a Ferret route in the runner; what matters is that nothing is delivered and the window closes, which the runner checks (a window still open, or a new item in the vault, fails the case). (Before: {"ceremony":"none","route":"none","maxWindows":1}.)
